findings.quoted_text: Except as otherwise detailed in this Agreement, the Parties acknowledge and agree that the Subject Program including without limitation the Deliverables and Documentation (collectively, the Works) are "work made for hire" in accordance with the U.S. Copyright Act, 17 U.S.C. § 101 et seq. Accordingly, Client will be the copyright author and owner of all of the Works. To the extent permissible, Developer hereby assigns and transfers to Client all copyright and other intellectual property ownership in the Works.

findings.explanation: Intellectual property ownership of your work transfers to the client immediately upon creation through work-made-for-hire and present assignment terms, before you are guaranteed full payment.
findings.suggested_change: The Contractor retains all intellectual property rights in the Deliverables until the Client makes full payment of all applicable fees, upon which ownership of the final Deliverables shall transfer to the Client.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, Thank you for sharing the agreement. I have reviewed the terms and would like to propose a small adjustment before signing: - Regarding the relevant clause, intellectual property ownership transfers to the client immediately upon creation before full payment is guaranteed. I propose modifying this so that the Contractor retains all intellectual property rights in the Deliverables until the Client makes full payment of all applicable fees, upon which ownership of the final Deliverables shall transfer to the Client. Please let me know if this adjustment works for you. Best regards,
